```
OFFICER'S CERTIFICATE

Dated: [CLOSING DATE]

1. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES. Each of the representations and warranties of 
   the Company set forth in the Purchase Agreement, dated as of [SIGNING DATE] 
   (the "Agreement"), are:
   (a) with respect to Fundamental Representations, true and correct in all respects 
       as of the date hereof; and
   (b) with respect to all other representations and warranties, true and correct in 
       all respects as of the date hereof, except where the failure to be true and 
       correct would not reasonably be expected to have, individually or in the 
       aggregate, a Material Adverse Effect;
   in each case, as though made on and as of the date hereof (except for 
   representations and warranties expressly made as of a specific date, which are 
   true and correct as of such date).

2. COVENANTS. The Company has performed and complied, in all material respects, 
   with each of the covenants and obligations required to be performed or complied 
   with by it under the Agreement at or prior to the Closing.

3. NO MATERIAL ADVERSE EFFECT. No event, change, circumstance, development, 
   condition, occurrence, or effect has occurred since [SIGNING DATE] that has had, 
   or would reasonably be expected to have, individually or in the aggregate, a 
   Material Adverse Effect.

4. NO LITIGATION. No action, suit, proceeding, or investigation has been instituted 
   by any Governmental Authority seeking to restrain, enjoin, or otherwise prevent 
   the consummation of the transactions contemplated by the Agreement.

Capitalized terms used but not defined herein have the meanings given to them 
in the Agreement.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned has executed this Certificate as of the 
date first written above.

_________________________________
[NAME]
[TITLE]
[ENTITY]
```
